title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Apply Law in Cases of Disputes over Contracts for Transfer of Land-Use Rights of State-Owned Land Reclaimed for Farming

articles.content_en:
September 4, 2012
Supreme People's Court
Reply on How to Apply the Law in Cases Concerning Disputes over Land Use Rights Transfer Contracts for State-Owned Land Used for Farming after Reclamation
Fa Shi [2012] No. 14
(Adopted at the 1532nd meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on November 21, 2011; promulgated by the Announcement of the Supreme People's Court on September 4, 2012; and shall come into force as of November 1, 2012)
The Higher People's Court of Gansu Province:
Your Request for Instructions on How to Apply the Law to the Transfer of the Right to Operate State-Owned Land (Gan Gao Fa [2010] No. 84) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
State-owned land that has been used for farming after reclamation but has not been turned over to the farmers for collective use shall not fall within the scope of rural land as stipulated in Article 2 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Contracting of Rural Land. The transfer of the right to use such land shall not be governed by the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Contracting of Rural Land, but shall be regulated by the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, the Land Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant laws and regulations.
For a contract for the transfer of the right to use state-owned land that is used for farming after reclamation, if it does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations, and a party only requests confirmation that the contract is void on the ground that the transferor has failed to obtain the certificate of land use right, the People's Court shall not support it according to law; if a party, in accordance with the contract, requests that the other party perform the obligation to apply for the certificate of land use right, the People's Court shall support it according to law.
